Download the installer matching your operating system and architecture below. `SHA256SUMS` contains checksums for all installers.

`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-v<version>.txt` contains the combined third-party notices for all desktop platforms. Each installer also includes its platform-specific notices.

macOS builds are signed with a Developer ID Application certificate and notarized by Apple. macOS may still ask you to confirm opening an app downloaded from the Internet. Windows installers are unsigned and may show operating-system trust prompts.

Website and downloads: https://nightfall.live/downloads

Feedback and bug reports: https://github.com/stewartadam/nightfall-lightdesk/issues
